protocol.training_rule: opened before fold start AND resolution/closure label known before fold start
protocol.evaluation_rows: all P2/P3 KPI incidents opened in each outer month; identical rows for every model
protocol.primary_robust_metric: median of six monthly PR-AUC values
protocol.operational_guardrail: Recall@Top-5% must be at least 95% of champion (relative)
protocol.promotion_gate: >=15% robust PR-AUC improvement; >=4/6 monthly wins; <=5% relative Recall@Top-5% degradation; point-in-time safe
